subject: 421 High Street Mixed-Use Development
overview: The development team presented a proposal to replace a former funeral home at 421-423 High Street with a four-story mixed-use building containing nine residential units. The project will now proceed to formal city board reviews for required parking and setback variances.

items.title: Project Introduction and Site Overview
items.summary: Attorney Kathleen Desmond introduced the development team and the proposal to construct a four-story, nine-unit mixed-use building at the former Sincota Funeral Home site.

items.title: Architectural Design and Materials
items.summary: Peter Quinn detailed the architectural design, which features a brick base and fiber cement siding while preserving stained glass from the original funeral home.

items.title: Site Layout and Environmental Impacts
items.summary: The team reviewed landscape buffers, dark-sky compliant lighting, and a shadow study analyzing seasonal light patterns on neighboring residential properties.

items.title: Civil Engineering and Stormwater Management
items.summary: Jack Sullivan explained site engineering, including a one-way circulation pattern and a rain garden designed to reduce total impervious surface area by 7%.

items.title: Public Q&A and Permitting Timeline
items.summary: Neighbors raised concerns regarding building massing, traffic, and light pollution, and the team confirmed they will file for required parking and setback variances within the month.
